tei:div.tei:p: (ka)༄༅// rgyal dbang stag lung pa chen po'i zab chos las 'byung ba'i bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag tu med pa sprul sku'i dbang chog gsar bu dga' skyed ces bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// bla ma rin po che tshe dpag tu med pa la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir dpal stag lung pa yab sras kyi zhal lung bdud rtsi'i dgongs pa ltar rgyal ba tshe dpag tu med pa sprul sku'i rjes gnang ji ltar bya ba shin tu bsdus pa gsar bu dga' byed brjod par bya'o// de la stegs bu'i steng du tshe gtor bum gzugs/ 'bul gtor zlum po/ tshe ril tshe chang las bum rnams kyi mthar mchod pa bdun gyis bskor/ rang gi mdun du rdor dril 'thor nas sogs bsham/ sngon 'gro gtor ma gnyis kyi dang po bshams la/ rang nyid 'od dpag med mgon gyur/ oṃ padmānta kṛt hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddha sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las dam tshig rdzas// ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ chu dang bdud rtsis gtor ma gsum la bran/ rang gis bdud rtsi myang*/ oṃ padmānta= oṃ swa bhā wa= stong pa'i ngang las gtor ma'i rdzas sogs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sogs gsum/ gang yang 'dir gnas lha dang klu// gnod sbyin srin po'am gzhan dag la// sngags spyod don du sa phyogs 'di// bdag zhu khyed kyis stsal du gsol// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sogs nas/ kun 'grub mdzod/ oṃ sumbha ni sogs/ badzra rakṣa gsum/ oṃ padmānta kṛ t= oṃ swa bhā wa= stong pa'i ngang las mchod rdzas rnams// ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐ nas/ shabda āḥhūm̐ gi bar/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la sogs bdun/ tshogs zhing mdun du spyan drangs par gyur/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs gsum/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sems can bde ldan sdug bsngal bral// bde dang mi 'bral btang snyoms shog

/bdag mdun ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa= rang dang bum pa stong par gyur// de las rin chen bum nang du// rang nyid mtshungs par rin chen khri// pad zlas mdzes par bcom ldan 'das// tshe dpag med pa sku mdog dmar// chos gos ngur smrig rnam gsum gsol// rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs// mnyam gzhag phyag rgyas bai ḍūrya'i// lhung bzed bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin// mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa// 'od snang mtha' yas 'bar bar gsal// bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shin tu rnam par nges pa gzi brjid kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo// phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags pa dang sogs/ oṃ badzra ā yu ṣe/ sa ra he/ ka ra re/ shwa ra re hūm̐ phaṭa/ mdun bskyed thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis// 'khor 'das lam gyi bcud bsdus pa// lhung bzed nang zhugs khol zhing lud// bum pa gang zhing rang nyid lha'i// sna bug rlung gis rab drangs te// lus kun tshe dang ye shes kyi// bdud rtsis ltem gyis khengs par gyur// las bum dbus su pad nyi hrīḥ /de las rta mgrin dmar po ni// dbyug to sdigs mdzub de'i sku las// babs pas bdud rtsis bum pa gang*// oṃ a mā ra ṇi dzī wanti ye swā hā/ zhes pa dang*/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te nas/ samya ksaṃ buddha ya/ tadyathā/ oṃ sarba saṃska ra nas/ wā re swā hā/ zhes ci nus bzla/ oṃ padmānta krita sogs zhes nyer gcig tsam brjod/ slob ma rnams las bum gyi chus phyi rol nas khrus byas gral du 'khod pa na/ sngon 'gro gtor ma gnyis pa la chu dang bdud rtsis bran/ oṃ padmānta kṛ ta/ oṃ swa bhā wa= stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i snod du kham̐ las mchod gtor bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin mkha' khyab tu gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsum/ a kā ro sogs gsum/ gang yang 'dir gnas sogs/

oṃ sumbha ni sogs kyis/ spos rol dang yungs kar gyis brabs te bgegs bskrad/ oṃ badzra rakṣa sogs/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i rang bzhin bar chad thams cad srung ba'i nus pa can du gyur/ me tog bkye bsdu bya/ 'o na/ sems can thams cad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la 'god par bya/ de'i ched du bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag tu med pa'i dbang bskur ba zhus nas bskyed rdzogs rnams nyams su len snyam pa mdzod/ de yang bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag tu med pa'am/ 'od dpag tu med pa zhes bya ba 'dis/ sngon de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten dbang phyug rgyal po'i drung du/ rang gi sku tshe grangs med pa dang sems can gzhan yang 'chi ba las skyob par smon lam mdzad/ mthar bde ba can du sangs rgyas tshe dpag med par byung nas/ mtshan 'dzin pa tsam gyis tshe dang ye shes rgyas par mdzad/ 'di ni bde ba can gyi mdo gzungs phan yon dang bcas pa da ltar tshe mdor grags pa dang*/ bde mchog 'bum pa'i rgyud dang*/ 'jam dpal dpa' bo gcig grub la sogs pa du ma nas gsungs/ 'phags yul du slob dpon dze tā ri sogs mang pos gsal bar mdzad pa las/ 'dir skabs su bab pa'i lo rgyus ni/ rje btsun ras chung pa zhes bya ba dpal phyag na rdo rje'i sprul pa de nyid rje te phu pa'i spyan sngar phebs pa'i dus bla ma wa la tsaṇḍa'i zhal nas khyod tshe thung par 'ong*/ lo lnga bcu las mi thub gsungs skad/ der ras chung pa thugs bred de/ bod ston dus 'khor ba gcig dang*/ kha che dus 'khor ba gcig dang*/ yul dbus kyi dus 'khor ba gcig rnams la dris pas gsum ka mthun par byung bas/ te phu pa la gser gyi maṇḍal phul nas bdag tshe thung bar 'dug zer bas/ gsang sngags thabs che ba dang thabs mang bar gda' bas tshe sring ba'i thabs bdog na thugs la 'dogs par zhu zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ khyod 'og klu dkar mo'i bur 'dug

tshe shin tu thung bar 'ong*/ shes rab shin tu che bar 'ong*/ tshe sring ba'i gdams ngag ngas kyang shes te/ nga'i phyi mo yang yin/ bla ma yang yin/ mkha' 'gro ma su kha siddhi zhes kyang bya/ khar kha yang zer/ grub pa'i rgyal mo yang zer/ dgung lo sum brgya lon pa/ jo mo ku ru kulle las dngos grub thob pa/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang lab di ri ri byed pa zhig yod/ khong nyin mo mis de tsam du mi mthong dur khrod du mar gshegs/ mtshan mo co pa ri chung ngu zhig tu mar me mtshan thub zhig spar nas gcig pur bzhugs pas khong la zhus/ ma gnang na ngas bshad kyis gsungs/ der ras chung pas dur khrod rnams su btsal bas sngar bla mas gsungs pa bzhin du bzhugs pa dang mjal gser gyi maṇḍal phul nas tshe sring ba'i gdams ngag zhus pas/ mkha' 'gro ma'i zhal nas/ ngas do nub khyod la phan thogs sam mi thogs brtag pa byas la phan thogs par 'dug na nangs par gdams ngag sbyin gsungs skad/ de'i nub rang yang lab di ri ri 'dug pas/ jo mo su dang lab pa lags zhus pas/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang lab pa yin gsungs/ nangs par ji skad gsung snyam 'dug tsa na/ tho rangs mkha' 'gro ma'i zhal nas/ bod kyi rnal 'byor pa khyod yar langs shig khyod skal ba dang ldan par 'dug pas ngas phan thogs par 'dug gi/ khyod lo ji tsam thub par 'dod gsungs nas gdams ngag thams cad rdzogs par gnang*/ rje ras chung pa'i zhal nas ngas gdams ngag 'di ma chag par nyams su blangs na/ ras chung pas lo brgya thub zer ba 'ong bar snang ba la/ gsang sngags kyi chos mang po zhig nyams su longs nas/ da yang shi ma shi med snyam res chag par byas pas lo 'di tsam zhu ba gsungs te dgung lo dgu bcu rtsa brgyad bzhugs par gda'/ skyes bu ras chung rdo rje grags pa des/ rje bur sgom nag po la gdams/ des 'gro ba'i mgon po dpal phag mo gru pa la/ des mnyam med rgyal dbang stag lung pa chen po la phul te thugs dam tshe dpag rnam gsum gyi ya gyal yin/

rje btsun de nas rim pa bzhin sku yal sprul pa'i skyes mchog sogs 'og tu 'byung ba'i brgyud rim bton la/ rtsa ba'i bla ma des bdag la'o// de lta bu'i bcom ldan 'das kyi rjes su gnang ba'i tshul mchog gi sprul pa'i sku rje btsun sangs rgyas dbon grags pa dpal 'od zer bzang po'i zhal lung ltar bsgrub par bgyid pa la/ slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams grub nas khyed rang gi ngo skal du maṇḍal zhig mdzad par zhu/ de ltar maṇḍal gyis mtshams sbyar nas gsol ba gdab pa'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kun mkhyen ye shes sogs/ mdun gyi nam mkhar tshe dpag tu med pa'i lha tshogs rgya mtsho lta bur bzhugs pa'i drung du/ skyabs 'gro bshags pa yi rang sems bskyed rnams bsgrub snyam lan mo mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs gsum da rjes gnang gi gzhi bca' ba'i ched du dmigs pa 'di ltar mdzod/ oṃ padmānta kṛ ta sogs/ swā bhā lwa= stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rma byas btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri/ pam̐ las padma dmar po 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba/ de'i steng du yi ge hrīḥdamar po ring cha tshig drag dang bcas pa/ de las 'od 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag tu med pa sku mdog dmar po/ chos gos ngur smrig rnam gsum gsol ba sprul pa'i sku'i cha byad can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa phyag mnyam gzhag mdzad pa'i steng na lhung bzed tshe'i bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams pa/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan pa/ 'od dang 'od zer mtha' yas pa 'phro ba de'i gnas gsum du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ thugs ka'i steng du yi ge hrīḥdamar po de las 'od 'phros/ bde ba can dang mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor dang phyogs bcu'i zhing thams cad nas tshe dpag tu med pa'i sku grangs med pa nyi zer gyi rdul 'khrugs pa ltar byon/

khyed rang rnams la thim pas gnyis su med par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badzra ā be sha ya aḥ.āḥ spos rol/ da dbang gi dngos gzhi'i don du dmigs pa 'di ltar mdzod/ khyed rang gi spyi bo'i gtsug tu tshe gtor 'di nyid rma byas bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri pad zla'i steng du bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag tu med pa nas/ 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro ba/ khyed rang lhar gsal ba'i lus kyi dbus su rtsa a wa dhū ti phyi dkar la nang dmar ba dang bcas pa bsgom mdzod/ de nas spyi bo'i bla ma tshe dpag tu med pa la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la nas/ nam mkha' rdo rje deng bdag stsol// de ltar gsol ba btab pas/ spyi bo'i tshe dpag tu med pa'i thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi bla tshe yar nyams/ phyi rol 'byung ba bzhi'i nang du gnas pa'i bcud/ mthu yon tan/ zag bcas 'khor ba pa dang*/ zag med mya ngan las 'das pa'i nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyis bsdus te tshe dpag tu med pa'i sku la thim/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sku las babs pa'i bdud rtsi dang phyag gi lhung bzed chang gi bdud rtsi rgya cher lud pa khyed rang gi tshangs bug nas zhugs rtsa dbu ma'i nang brgyud smin mtshams yan chad gang*/ lus kyi dri ma dag bum pa'i dbang thob/ bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul sku 'grub pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ gtor ma mgor bkod/ a mā ra ṇi sogs/ spos rol/ yang bcom ldan 'das kyi sku dang phyag gi lhung bzed nang gi bdud rtsi byung ba dbu ma'i nang brgyud mgrin pa yan chad gang*/ ngag gi dri ma dag gsang ba'i dbang thob/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku 'grub pa'i skal pa dang ldan par gyur snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ gtor ma mgor bkod pa sogs/

yang bcom ldan 'das kyi sku dang phyag gi lhung bzed nang nas babs pa'i bdud rtsi dbu ma'i nang brgyud/ snying ga yan chad gang*/ yid kyi dri ma dag shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ pho nya'i lam bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku 'grub pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ gtor ma mgor bkod pa sogs/ yang bcom ldan 'das kyi sku dang phyag gi lhung bzed nang gi bdud rtsi byung ba dbu ma'i nang brgyud long bu yan chad gang*/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma thams cad dag tshig dbang rin po che thob/ phyag rgya chen po bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku 'grub pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ gtor ma mgor bkod pa sogs/ de ltar tshe dang ye shes kyi bdud rtsi byang chub sems rgyun gyis lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ gyen du 'phyur zhing lud pa las/ khyed rang gi spyi bo'i gtsug tu rigs kyi bdag po tshe dpag tu med pa brtan par bzhugs nas byin gyis rlob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ rgyal ba 'od dpag tu med pa/ ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo/ ras chung rdo rje grags pa/ rnal 'byor bur sgom nag po/ 'gro mgon phag mo gru pa/ dpal ldan stag lung pa chen po/ sku yal sprul pa'i skyes mchog chos sku sangs rgyas yar byon/ rje btsun sangs rgyas dbon grags pa dpal 'od zer bzang po/ sku zhang rin chen bsod nams dpal/ chos sku o rgyan mgon po/ bla ma rgyal bzang*/ bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ blo gros rin chen/ don grub rin chen/ chos dpal bzang po/ mkhar drung bsod nams bkra shis/ rje drung mtsho skyes rdo rje/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bkra shis/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ngag gi dbang po/ mchog sprul bkra shis dpal grub/ khyab bdag grags pa legs grub/ 'phags mchog ngag dbang grags pa/ dam chos phrin las phun tshogs/ ngag dbang phrin las bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal/

grub mchog sgom pa ngag dbang phul ldan/ bkra shis grags pa ye shes/ bkra shis dge legs bzang po/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang bstan pa'i nyi ma'i bar du byon pa rnams dang*/ mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa'i lha dang sngags dang ting nge 'dzin gyi byin rlabs slob ma 'di'i rgyud la 'jug par gyur cig nad zhi bar gyur cig gdon las grol bar gyur cig 'chi ba med pa'i tshe dang ye shes kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ oṃ a mā ra ṇi sogs/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sogs/ gtor ma mgor bkod/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i sogs brjod me tog 'thor/ dngos grub kyi rdzas la longs spyod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bkra shis tshe brtan dpal gyi zas// snying po bsdus pa'i bcud 'di ni// de ring bu yis za bar gyis// 'di zos sangs rgyas tshe dpag med// 'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med// oṃ a mā ra ṇi sogs/ tshe ril tshe chang sbyin/ bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag tu med pas/ slob ma 'di la 'chi ba med pa tshe dang ye shes kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ tshe mi 'gyur ba g.yung drung du mdzod cig /mi shigs pa rdo rjer mdzod cig /mi nub pa rgyal mtshan du mdzod cig /nyin mo bde legs sogs/ de nas slob dpon tshe dpag tu med par gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sngags phreng las 'phros pa'i sngags phreng khyed rang gi snying ga'i zla ba la gnas pa'i sa bon gyi mthar 'khod par mos nas rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ a mā ra ṇi sogs bdun/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sogs/ gsum/ slar yang gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi// sogs gsum/ slob dpon la me tog 'thor/ ngo bo sngags phreng rnam pa me tog dmar po spyi bor bzhag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs/ mdzad du gsol/ oṃ su pu tiṣṭha badzra ya swā hā/ gsum gyis me tog slob ma'i mgor bkod/ de ltar rgyal ba tshe dpag tu med pa'i dbang zab mo gsan pa'i skabs su thob pa'i dam tshig rnams bsrung snyam pas rjes zlos mdzod/

gtso bos ji ltar sogs gsum/ de ltar dbang thob pa'i yon du maṇḍal zhig mdzad 'tshal/ maṇḍal phul nas slob ma rnams grol/ slob dpon gyis/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ pā dyaṃ puṣpe nas/ shabda āḥhūm̐/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo tshe dpag med nas/ phyag 'tshal lo// oṃ badzra sa twa sa ma ya sogs/ yig brgya lan gsum/ de nas mdun gyi bcom ldan 'das// rang la thim pas bdag nyid kyang*// mgon po tshe dpag med pa'i sku// rtag brtan gzhom gzhig med par gyur// oṃ badzra muḥ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /tshe dpag med mgon sogs dang*/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo sogs/ bkra shis rgyas par bya'o// yang tshe dbang brgya rtsa bskur bar 'dod na/ gong ltar dbang rgyas pa gcig grub rjes/ maṇḍal/ slar yang dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i ngo bo tshe bum rgyal ba 'od dpag tu med par gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hrīḥyig gi 'od kyis/ khyed rang gi tshe bsod yar nyams/ phyi rol 'byung ba chen po bzhi'i nang na gnas pa'i bcud mthu yon tan zag bcas 'khor ba dang zag med mya ngan las 'das pa'i nus bcud dang yon tan ma lus pa bsdus nas spyan drangs/ mdun bskyed kyi sku dang phyag gi lhung bzed nang gi bdud rtsi la thim/ sku dang phyag gi lhung bzed nang gi bdud rtsi las bdud rtsi'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon pa rnams khyed rang gi tshangs bug nas zhugs/ rtsa a wa dhū ti brgyud spyi mgrin snying ga rkang mthil yan chad gang*/ dri ma bzhi dag dbang bzhi thob/ lam bzhi bsgom pa la dbang*/ sku bzhi 'grub pa'i skal ba can du gyur/ bdud rtsi gyen du rgya cher lud pas spyi bor tshe dpag tu med par gyur nas brtan par bzhugs te tshe'i dngos grub rtag tu stsol ba'i mos pa mdzod/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang brgyud pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pas/

rdo rje slob ma 'di la 'chi ba med pa'i tshe dang ye shes kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ oṃ a mā ra ṇi dzī banti ye swā hā/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ a pa ri mi ta ces sogs dang*/ bkra shis tshe brtan sogs kyis tshe ril tshe chang sbyin/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo tshe dpag med sogs kyis shis brjod byed/ yang maṇḍal phul nas/ slar yang dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i ngo bo tshe bum rgyal ba 'od dpag tu med par gsal ba sogs gong ltar bsdus pa 'di nyid bsag mthar yang dbang rgyas pa re mdzad pa phyag len yin la/ rjes su mchod bstod sogs gong ltar ro// zhes pa 'di blo gros dman pa la phan phyir byang stag lung pa dge slong ngag dbang bkra shis dpal grub kyis dngos po'i lo rta zla ba'i tshes bcu dgu la dge 'phel chos rdzong du sbyar ba'o// sarba dā maṅgalaṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
